a_before_b.rationale: Deciding whether to finetune does not require understanding the mechanics of supervised finetuning; one can make that decision based on data, hardware, and talent constraints without knowing how SFT works.

b_before_a.rationale: Meaningfully deciding whether to finetune requires understanding what supervised finetuning actually does to a model, so SFT is a prerequisite for the when-to-finetune decision.
